metadata.rationale: SOP 6: this operation records the Embed activity and no other.
SOP 6: this operation records the Map activity and no other.
SOP 8.1: a gate is met, blocked, unassessed or not_applicable with authorized rationale.
SOP 7.6: episode-level outcomes never close a case.

SOP 3.2 (design constraint I-2, E 3): the evaluated executor never attests its own independent acceptance. The expression is the permitted state: the settler is not the executor. Delegation-chain containment is a list and is not expressible (L2).
SOP 3.2: in a one-person case independent settlement is performed by a fresh verifier, recorded as such. Only the recorded attestation is checkable; actual freshness of context is not.
SOP 6: this operation records the Observe activity and no other.
SOP 7.6: continue, revise and escalate leave the case open (case-level only).
SOP 7.3: within-reference corrections are allowed; a change to success criteria starts a new authorized evaluation version. A move may not carry changed criteria.
SOP 3.2: the evaluated executor never rewrites frozen criteria. The expression is the permitted state: the principal freezing a reference is not the executor.
SOP 8.1: not applicable never waives a hard governance condition.
SOP 6: this operation records the Compound activity and no other.
SOP 6: this operation records the Artifactize activity and no other.
SOP 6 (Validate): compare against predeclared expectations.
SOP 6: this operation records the Learn activity and no other.
SOP 7.6: close-satisfied and close-failed set lifecycle closed (case-level dispositions only).
SOP 6: this operation records the Validate activity and no other.
SOP 7.6: lifecycle closed requires a terminal case record.

SOP 7.2 (design constraint I-1, E 3): for an evaluated path the reference is fixed before execution. No move on an evaluated episode unless its freeze is recorded; an exploratory episode is labelled exploratory instead.
SOP 7.6: suspend sets lifecycle suspended (case-level only).
SOP 6: this operation records the Prototype activity and no other.
SOP 6: this operation records the Deploy activity and no other.
SOP 6: this operation records the Instrument activity and no other.

SOP 2.2 and 7.2 (design constraint I-3, E 3): one frozen reference per (case, plan item, n). The expression is the permitted state: no earlier freeze exists for the key. The count is supplied by the caller; DomainForge does not check uniqueness itself.
SOP 7.6: lifecycle closed requires a recorded case-level close disposition. This record is that disposition, so a closed lifecycle_after is permitted only for a case-level close.
SOP 7.3: SEA-Forge authorization is obtained at the action boundary for consequential actions.
